description: 3-stage JWT claims injection via metadata passthrough: (1) add JWT claim mapping helper for SSO integration that maps standard claims like sub and email_verified, (2) add user metadata support so users can store department/team metadata at signup, (3) enable flexible role mapping for enterprise customers by looping through user.metadata and copying any key starting with x-hasura- into JWT extraClaims. Attacker sets metadata {"x-hasura-allowed-roles": ["admin"]} at signup and gets admin JWT.
